hypothesis: There is one code C_g=g+s_g for each of22working signs g; s_g is any fixed finite possibly empty sequence over the same22signs. Each complete native whole group is a concatenation of these codes. Source-letter values are arbitrary global bijective labels of code heads. No erased characters, aliases, context, controls, changing spacing, line reset or copy errors. Distinct first signs make all22codes prefix-free. A nontrivial used code has length>1 and actually occurs in at least one complete parsed group.

search: At each node parse each distinct eligible whole form from its beginning through currently assigned codes. A mismatch or code extending past group end is a contradiction. Stop each remaining form at its first unassigned head. For a chosen pending head g, the code must be one of ALL nonempty prefixes of the longest common prefix of every currently reached residual starting g. Choose smallest such domain then inventory order; try longest prefix first. Exhaust every child unless a verified nontrivial used witness is found or budget expires. When all groups parse, count actually used codes; identity-only leaf has no nontrivial witness, regardless of never-used unassigned codes. These can be completed arbitrarily without changing any observed word.
proof_scope: This is an exhaustive finite search over restrictions of arbitrary finite codes actually used in the observed groups, not a guessed maximum tail length. Every used code is a prefix of a currently reached finite residual. Branches partition its possible values. Unused codes do not explain observed redundancy.
